reason: A client-side DeepSeek Harness Web UI skin that adds neo-brutalist styling, two selectable color schemes, theme-aware layout overrides, and local preference persistence.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供支持明暗主题的粗野主义换肤、两套可切换配色方案及本地偏好设置。
summaries.en: A client-side DeepSeek Harness Web UI skin providing theme-aware neo-brutalist styling, two switchable color schemes, and locally persisted preferences.

capabilities: Applies light and dark theme token overrides to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
Provides two switchable visual schemes with an enable/disable toggle
Persists scheme and enabled state in browser localStorage
